scripts.dev: node scripts/check-deps.cjs && node scripts/run-with-log.cjs --name dev -- pnpm dev:raw
scripts.dev:log: node scripts/check-deps.cjs && node scripts/run-with-log.cjs --name dev -- pnpm dev:raw
scripts.dev:desktop:shell: node scripts/wait-for-port.cjs --port 3000 && node scripts/wait-for-port.cjs --port 5173 && pnpm --filter @ai-novel/desktop dev
scripts.dev:desktop: node scripts/check-deps.cjs && node scripts/run-with-log.cjs --name desktop-dev -- pnpm dev:desktop:raw
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @ai-novel/shared build && pnpm --filter @ai-novel/server build && pnpm --filter @ai-novel/client build
scripts.build:desktop:backend: pnpm --filter @ai-novel/shared build && pnpm --filter @ai-novel/server prisma:generate && pnpm --filter @ai-novel/server build
scripts.build:desktop:all: pnpm --filter @ai-novel/shared build && pnpm --filter @ai-novel/server prisma:generate && pnpm --filter @ai-novel/server build && pnpm --filter @ai-novel/client build:desktop && pnpm --filter @ai-novel/desktop build
scripts.dist:desktop:nsis: pnpm run stage:desktop && node desktop/scripts/run-electron-builder.cjs --win nsis --x64
scripts.dist:desktop:portable: pnpm run stage:desktop && node desktop/scripts/run-electron-builder.cjs --win portable --x64
scripts.verify:desktop-package: pnpm run stage:desktop && node desktop/scripts/run-electron-builder.cjs --dir --win --x64 && node desktop/scripts/verify-desktop-package.cjs
scripts.verify:desktop-package:mac: pnpm run stage:desktop && node desktop/scripts/run-electron-builder.cjs --dir --mac --arm64 --x64 && node desktop/scripts/verify-desktop-package.cjs --platform mac
scripts.typecheck: NODE_OPTIONS="${NODE_OPTIONS:---max-old-space-size=8192}" pnpm --filter @ai-novel/shared build && NODE_OPTIONS="${NODE_OPTIONS:---max-old-space-size=8192}" pnpm --filter @ai-novel/server typecheck && pnpm --filter @ai-novel/client typecheck && pnpm --filter @ai-novel/desktop typecheck
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @ai-novel/shared lint && pnpm --filter @ai-novel/server lint && pnpm --filter @ai-novel/client lint
scripts.test:rust: cargo test -p novel-domain -p novel-workflow -p novel-llm -p novel-storage-sqlite -p novel-application
scripts.build:tauri:e2e: cargo tauri build --features e2e --config src-tauri/tauri.e2e.conf.json --target aarch64-apple-darwin --bundles app
